propositions: Extract identity transition state machine (bind, confirm, unbind, numeric-ID re-key, stale reverse cleanup) from BindingStore into a cohesive BindingLifecycle slice while preserving all existing behaviors exactly.
Every bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward entry and one matching reverse entry, verified by reloading both indexes from disk.
bind_confirm remains last-writer-wins on forward entry and pops EXACTLY the one differing old reverse key with no sweep, no ambiguity detection, and no abort.
Stale reverse entries are removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind, numeric-ID re-key, and _retire; any other removal must safety-abort.
Immutable numeric-ID re-key operation moves issues by swapping both indexes and resetting absence count, extracted as a named rekey operation returning success boolean.
note_absent_or_rekey facade method remains coordinator delegating re-key attempt to BindingLifecycle; on negative result it falls through to note_absent without behavior change.
